description: This file implements a WebRTC transport layer for Pipecat, including classes for managing WebRTC connections, media tracks, and transport logic for both input and output streams. It handles real-time audio/video communication, application messaging, and client connection events, utilizing aiortc and related libraries.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCCallbacks
classes.description: Defines callback handlers for WebRTC events such as app messages, client connections, and disconnections.

classes.name: RawAudioTrack
classes.description: Custom audio track for WebRTC, managing audio frame buffering, timing, and synchronization.

classes.name: RawVideoTrack
classes.description: Custom video track for WebRTC, managing video frame queuing and conversion.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCClient
classes.description: Manages WebRTC peer connection, media tracks, and event handling for audio/video streams and messaging.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCInputTransport
classes.description: Handles incoming media streams and application messages from WebRTC peers.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCOutputTransport
classes.description: Handles outgoing media streams and messages to WebRTC peers.

classes.name: SmallWebRTCTransport
classes.description: Main transport class integrating input/output transports with WebRTC connection management.

methods.name: _convert_frame
methods.description: Converts video frames to RGB format based on source format.

methods.name: read_video_frame
methods.description: Reads and processes video frames from WebRTC connection, converting to RGB and creating UserImageRawFrame.

methods.name: read_audio_frame
methods.description: Reads and processes audio frames from WebRTC connection, resampling if necessary, and creating InputAudioRawFrame.

methods.name: write_audio_frame
methods.description: Sends an audio frame to WebRTC connection.

methods.name: write_video_frame
methods.description: Sends a video frame to WebRTC connection.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the client with transport parameters and initial frame data.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes WebRTC connection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from WebRTC peer.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends application message via WebRTC.

methods.name: _handle_client_connected
methods.description: Handles WebRTC client connection event, setting up media tracks.

methods.name: _handle_peer_disconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup on peer disconnection.

methods.name: _handle_client_closed
methods.description: Handles cleanup on client connection close.

methods.name: _handle_app_message
methods.description: Processes incoming application messages.

methods.name: _can_send
methods.description: Checks if connection is ready to send data.

methods.name: is_connected
methods.description: Property indicating WebRTC connection status.

methods.name: is_closing
methods.description: Property indicating if connection is closing.

methods.name: input
methods.description: Returns the input transport instance.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Returns the output transport instance.

methods.name: send_image
methods.description: Sends an image frame through the transport.

methods.name: send_audio
methods.description: Sends an audio frame through the transport.

methods.name: capture_participant_video
methods.description: Triggers capture of participant's video stream.

methods.name: capture_participant_audio
methods.description: Triggers capture of participant's audio stream.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, including user image requests.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the input transport and WebRTC connection.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the input transport and disconnects.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the input transport and disconnects immediately.

methods.name: _receive_audio
methods.description: Background task for receiving audio frames.

methods.name: _receive_video
methods.description: Background task for receiving video frames.

methods.name: push_app_message
methods.description: Pushes an application message into the pipeline.

methods.name: request_participant_image
methods.description: Requests an image frame from participant video stream.

methods.name: capture_participant_media
methods.description: Captures media from specified participant source.
